attendance.note: Press figure: 'over 120,000 attendees on the Saturday alone' in 2021 (Stuff, 28 Mar 2021, as cited on Wikipedia; article not opened). Wikipedia and guides describe a usual crowd of up to 100,000 across both days. No organiser count for 2026 found.

ticket_price.note: Free street festival with no gates.

audience.psychographics: Family-friendly, all-ages street festival crowd of Wellington locals and visitors drawn by music, art, parades, dance and food across the Cuba Quarter.

notes: Large, open partner programme run by Creative Capital Arts Trust, with clear tiers (Core Funder, Foundation, Programme, Supporting, Event Delivery). Important for an activation: the FAQ says 'Flyering and sampling are not allowed', so sampling-led activations would need a programme partnership instead. Orchestra Wellington is listed as a programme partner but is a performer, so not added. Years set to 2026 because the page was current at crawl; some partners carry over from earlier years.
